```{r}
moral<-read.csv( "data/stimuli.csv") %>% 
  select(ID,moral=rot.moral.foundations) %>% 
    mutate(ID = as.factor(ID))

df<-read.csv( "data/df_all_long_updated.csv") %>% 
  mutate(rater=ifelse(label_type=="human","human","llm")) %>% 
  mutate(unique_id=paste0(label_type,"_",human_id)) %>% 
  mutate(ID=as.factor(ID)) %>% 
  mutate(
  across(
    ends_with(c("_reaction", "_reaction_should")),
    ~ case_when(
      .x %in% c("Celebrate / praise", "Praise") ~ "Praise",
      .x %in% c("Do nothing") ~ "Do nothing",
      .x %in% c("Gossip", "Gossip about / discuss with / complain to others informally") ~ "Gossip",
      .x %in% c("Inform authority", "Inform the authorities, such as the police") ~ "Inform authority",
      .x %in% c("Physical confrontation") ~ "Physical confrontation",
      .x %in% c("Stay away", "Stay away or keep a distance from the actor") ~ "Stay away",
      .x %in% c("Support", "Support the actor") ~ "Support",
      .x %in% c("Verbal confrontation", "Verbal reprimand / verbal confrontation") ~ "Verbal confrontation",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )
) %>% 
  left_join(moral, by = "ID") %>% 
    mutate(source = ifelse(label_type %in% c("claude","gemini","gpt_5.2"),"close-source",ifelse(label_type=="human","human","open-source")))
```

# emotion 

```{r}
emotion_long <- df %>%
  select(rater,unique_id,label_type,source, ID,moral, target=emotion_type,emotion,strength_value) %>% 
  filter(strength_value>0) %>% 
  mutate(
    target = dplyr::recode(
      target,
      "emotion_actor" = "actor",
      "emotion_friend" = "strong tie",
      "emotion_acquaintance" = "weak tie",
      "emotion_stranger" = "stranger"
    ),
    target = factor(target, levels = c("actor", "strong tie", "weak tie", "stranger"))
  )

```
### test 

```{r}
chi_results_emotion <- emotion_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(moral), !is.na(emotion), !is.na(source), !is.na(target), emotion != "") %>%
  group_by(source, target) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    tab <- table(.x$moral, .x$emotion)

    if (nrow(tab) < 2 || ncol(tab) < 2 || sum(tab) == 0) {
      return(tibble(
        statistic = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        label = "NA (low variation)"
      ))
    }

    test <- tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(test)) {
      return(tibble(
        statistic = NA_real_,
        df = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        label = "NA (failed)"
      ))
    }

    tibble(
      statistic = unname(test$statistic),
      df = unname(test$parameter),
      p_value = test$p.value,
      label = ifelse(test$p.value < .001, "***", "ns")
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

print(chi_results_emotion)
```


### plot
```{r, fig.width=10,fig.height=6}

# set emotion order
emotion_order <- c(
  "Shame",
  "Guilt",
  "Embarrassment",
  "Contempt",
  "Disgust",
  "Anger",
  "Pride",
  "Compassion"
)

# set custom colors
emotion_cols <- c(
  "Shame" = "#E69F00",
  "Guilt" = "#56B4E9",
  "Embarrassment" = "#009E73",
  "Contempt" = "#F0E442",
  "Disgust" = "#0072B2",
  "Anger" = "#D55E00",
  "Pride" = "#CC79A7",
  "Compassion" = "#666666"
)

# compute proportions within each panel
emotion_props <- emotion_long %>%
  count(source, moral, target, emotion) %>%
  group_by(source, moral, target) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(emotion = factor(emotion, levels = emotion_order))

# plot
p_emotion <- ggplot(
  emotion_props,
  aes(x = moral, y = prop, fill = emotion, color = emotion)
) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_text(
  aes(label = ifelse(prop >= 0.05, scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1), "")),
  position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
  color = "black",
  size = 2
)+
  facet_grid(source ~ target) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("-.*", "", x)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = emotion_cols, breaks = emotion_order, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = emotion_cols, breaks = emotion_order, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    y = "Emotion Distribution (%)",
    x = "Moral Foundation"

    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

p_emotion

  filename = "output/p_emotion.png",
  plot = p_emotion,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# action by moral foundation
### dataset
```{r}
action_vars <- c(
  "strangers_reaction",
  "acquaintances_reaction",
  "friends_reaction",
  "strangers_reaction_should",
  "acquaintances_reaction_should",
  "friends_reaction_should"
)

df_action <- df %>%
  select(rater,unique_id,label_type, ID,moral,source, all_of(action_vars)) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  rename_with(~ .x %>%
    # tie strength
    str_replace("^strangers", "stranger") %>%
    str_replace("^acquaintances", "weak_tie") %>%
    str_replace("^friends", "strong_tie") %>%
    # action type
    str_replace("_reaction_should$", "_should") %>%
    str_replace("_reaction$", "_would"),
    all_of(action_vars)
  )

df_long <- df_action %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = stranger_would:strong_tie_should,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "response"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # optional: clean ordering of responses
    response = factor(response,
      levels = c(
        "Do nothing", "Stay away", "Gossip",
        "Inform authority", "Verbal confrontation",
        "Physical confrontation", "Support", "Praise"
      )
    ),
    # separate actual vs should (useful later)
    type = ifelse(grepl("should", variable), "should", "would")
  )

```

# wrongness x inapproperiateness


```{r}
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(norm_inappropriateness, norm_wrongness),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = case_when(
      measure == "norm_inappropriateness" ~ "Inappropriateness",
      measure == "norm_wrongness" ~ "Wrongness",
      TRUE ~ measure
    ),
    value = as.numeric(value)
  )

plot_dat <- df_long %>%
  count(source, measure, value) %>%
  group_by(source, measure) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

source_cols <- c(
  "human" = "#7F7F7F",
  "close-source" = "#E69F00",
  "open-source" = "#56B4E9"
)

# overall chi-square test for each measure
overall_test <- df_long %>%
  group_by(measure) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    tab <- table(.x$source, .x$value)
    test <- chisq.test(tab)

    tibble(
      chisq = unname(test$statistic),
      df = unname(test$parameter),
      p = test$p.value,
      label = paste0(
  "\u03C7\u00B2(", unname(test$parameter), ") = ",
  round(unname(test$statistic), 2),
  "\n",
  "p ", scales::pvalue(test$p.value, accuracy = 0.001)
)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    x = 2,
    y = 0.34
  )
overall_test

# pairwise chi-square tests within each measure
pairwise_test <- df_long %>%
  group_by(measure) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    pairs <- combn(sort(unique(.x$source)), 2, simplify = FALSE)

    map_dfr(pairs, function(pair) {
      dat_sub <- .x %>% filter(source %in% pair)
      tab <- table(dat_sub$source, dat_sub$value)
      test <- chisq.test(tab)

      tibble(
        source_1 = pair[1],
        source_2 = pair[2],
        chisq = unname(test$statistic),
        df = unname(test$parameter),
        p = test$p.value
      )
    })
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"),
    comparison = paste(source_1, "vs", source_2),
    result = paste0(
      comparison, ": ",
      "chi-square(", df, ") = ", round(chisq, 2),
      ", p = ", scales::pvalue(p_adj, accuracy = 0.001)
    )
  )

pairwise_test

```

## wrongness predict action

```{r}
# 1) build a long dataset with only the "Do nothing" outcome
df_dn <- df %>%
  transmute(
    label_type,
    source,
    norm_inappropriateness,
    norm_wrongness,
    strong_tie = !(friends_reaction %in% c("Do nothing", "Praise", "Support")),
    weak_tie   = !(acquaintances_reaction %in% c("Do nothing", "Praise", "Support")),
    stranger   = !(strangers_reaction %in% c("Do nothing", "Praise", "Support"))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(strong_tie, weak_tie, stranger),
    names_to = "tie",
    values_to = "sanction"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sanction = as.integer(sanction),
    tie = factor(tie, levels = c("strong_tie", "weak_tie", "stranger"))
  )

# 2) reshape the two norm measures into one column for easier modeling/faceting
df_dn_long <- df_dn %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(norm_inappropriateness, norm_wrongness),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "rating"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = case_when(
      measure == "norm_inappropriateness" ~ "Inappropriateness",
      measure == "norm_wrongness" ~ "Wrongness",
      TRUE ~ measure
    ),
    rating = as.numeric(rating)
  )

# 3) fit one model per tie x measure
models_dn <- df_dn_long %>%
  group_by(tie, measure) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map(function(dat) {
    mod <- glm(
      sanction ~ rating * label_type,
      data = dat,
      family = binomial
    )
    
    tibble(
      tie = dat$tie[1],
      measure = dat$measure[1],
      model = list(mod)
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# 4) get predicted probabilities
pred_dn <- pmap_dfr(
  models_dn,
  function(tie, measure, model) {
    
    newdata <- expand.grid(
      rating = 1:5,
      label_type = unique(model$data$label_type)
    )
    
    pred_se <- tryCatch(
      predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if (!is.null(pred_se)) {
      se <- pred_se$se.fit
      bad_se <- is.na(se) | se > 3
      
      newdata %>%
        mutate(
          predicted = plogis(pred_se$fit),
          conf.low = ifelse(bad_se, NA_real_, plogis(pred_se$fit - 1.96 * se)),
          conf.high = ifelse(bad_se, NA_real_, plogis(pred_se$fit + 1.96 * se)),
          tie = tie,
          measure = measure
        )
    } else {
      pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "response")
      
      newdata %>%
        mutate(
          predicted = pred,
          conf.low = NA_real_,
          conf.high = NA_real_,
          tie = tie,
          measure = measure
        )
    }
  }
)

# 5) relabel tie for plotting
pred_dn <- pred_dn %>%
  mutate(
    tie = case_when(
      tie == "strong_tie" ~ "strong tie",
      tie == "weak_tie" ~ "weak tie",
      tie == "stranger" ~ "stranger",
      TRUE ~ tie
    ),
    tie = factor(tie, levels = c("strong tie", "weak tie","stranger"))
  ) %>% 
  mutate(source = ifelse(label_type %in% c("claude","gemini","gpt_5.2"),"close-source",ifelse(label_type=="human","human","open-source"))) 


# 6) plot
p_sanction <- ggplot(
  pred_dn,
  aes(x = rating, y = predicted, color = label_type, fill = label_type)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = source),size = 3) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = NA
  ) +
  facet_grid(measure ~ tie) +
  labs(
    x = "Norm Rating",
    y = "P(Enforcement | Norm Ratings)",
    color = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +
 # scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
  "human" = 1,         # solid circle
  "close-source" = 17,  # triangle
  "open-source" = 8    # square
))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),  # facet labels
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13)
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2")


p_sanction

ggsave(
  filename = "output/normxsanction_all.png",
  plot = p_sanction,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r, warning=F}
non_enforcement <- c("Do nothing", "Praise", "Support")

df_action <- df %>%
  mutate(
    friends_enforce = as.integer(!(friends_reaction %in% non_enforcement)),
    acquaintances_enforce = as.integer(!(acquaintances_reaction %in% non_enforcement)),
    strangers_enforce = as.integer(!(strangers_reaction %in% non_enforcement))
  ) %>%
  filter(emotion_type != "emotion_actor")

combinations <- expand_grid(
  emotion = unique(df_action$emotion),
  emotion_type = unique(df_action$emotion_type)
)

fit_model_safe <- function(df, outcome_col) {
  vals <- unique(na.omit(df[[outcome_col]]))
  if (length(vals) < 2) return(NULL)

  glm(
    as.formula(paste0(outcome_col, " ~ strength_value * label_type")),
    data = df,
    family = binomial
  )
}

models <- pmap(
  combinations,
  function(emotion, emotion_type) {

    outcome_col <- case_when(
      emotion_type == "emotion_friend" ~ "friends_enforce",
      emotion_type == "emotion_acquaintance" ~ "acquaintances_enforce",
      emotion_type == "emotion_stranger" ~ "strangers_enforce"
    )

    df_sub <- df_action %>%
      filter(
        emotion == !!emotion,
        emotion_type == !!emotion_type
      )

    model <- fit_model_safe(df_sub, outcome_col)

    tibble(
      emotion = emotion,
      emotion_type = emotion_type,
      outcome = outcome_col,
      model = list(model)
    )
  }
) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null))

model_results <- models %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(model, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(tidy) %>%
  mutate(
    odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
    estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    std.error = round(std.error, 3),
    statistic = round(statistic, 2),
    p.value = signif(p.value, 3),
    odds_ratio = round(odds_ratio, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(
    emotion, emotion_type, outcome,
    term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, odds_ratio
  )

```

```{r, warning=F}
# ## 2. Generate predictions
pred_list <- pmap(
  models,
  function(emotion, emotion_type, outcome, model) {

    if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)
    if (!"label_type" %in% names(model$data)) return(NULL)

    newdata <- expand.grid(
      strength_value = 0:4,
      label_type = unique(model$data$label_type)
    )

    pred_se <- tryCatch(
      predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(pred_se)) {
      se <- pred_se$se.fit
      bad_se <- is.na(se) | se > 3

      out <- newdata %>%
        mutate(
          predicted = plogis(pred_se$fit),
          conf.low  = ifelse(bad_se, NA_real_, plogis(pred_se$fit - 1.96 * se)),
          conf.high = ifelse(bad_se, NA_real_, plogis(pred_se$fit + 1.96 * se))
        )
    } else {
      pred <- tryCatch(
        predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "response"),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (is.null(pred)) return(NULL)

      out <- newdata %>%
        mutate(
          predicted = pred,
          conf.low = NA_real_,
          conf.high = NA_real_
        )
    }

    out %>%
      mutate(
        emotion = emotion,
        emotion_type = emotion_type,
        outcome = outcome
      )
  }
)

pred_combined <- bind_rows(pred_list)

```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
## 3. Plot enforcement probability

emotionxenforcement <- pred_combined %>%  
  filter(emotion %in% c("Anger", "Contempt", "Disgust")) %>%
  mutate(
    emotion_type = case_when(
      emotion_type == "emotion_friend" ~ "strong tie",
      emotion_type == "emotion_acquaintance" ~ "weak tie",
      emotion_type == "emotion_stranger" ~ "stranger",
      TRUE ~ emotion_type
    ),
    emotion_type = factor(
      emotion_type,
      levels = c("strong tie", "weak tie", "stranger")
    ),
    source = ifelse(
      label_type %in% c("claude", "gemini", "gpt_5.2"),
      "close-source",
      ifelse(label_type == "human", "human", "open-source")
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = strength_value,
      y = predicted,
      color = label_type,
      fill = label_type
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    alpha = 0.25,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = source), size = 3) +
  facet_grid(
    emotion ~ emotion_type,
    labeller = labeller(
      emotion_type = function(x) sub(".*_", "", x)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Emotion Strength",
    y = "P(Enforcement | Emotion strength)",
    color = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 14),

  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(

    "close-source" = 17,

  ))
```
